narr: Modest moisture was located over the Rio Grande Valley with a weak upper trough extending just off to the west through southwestern New Mexico. Slow moving thunderstorms resulted in flash flooding in the Canutillo area.
ev: Flash flooding was reported at the intersection of Anthony and Doniphan Drive which caused a car to become stuck in the water.
lsr: MEDIA REPORTS FLOODING AT THE INTERSECTION OF ANTHONY AVE. AND DONIPHAN DR. IN CANUTILLO ALONG WITH A STUCK CAR.
